annotations.title: Watch a search for new results

description: Save a search of jobs, companies or people and come back for what is new: kind is jobs, companies or people, filters are the arguments of search_jobs, search_companies or search_people (e.g. {"role":"Backend","country":"DE","work_mode":"remote"}). Answers the first page now (newest first, compact) and a watch_id; check_watch with it later returns only the rows that appeared since. Up to 20 watches per agent (an account, a wallet, or a network and client name). Use it for a job hunt, a hiring pipeline or a market you follow. Free. Docs: https://alion.io/developers/docs

filters.description: The search arguments to follow (cursor and limit are ignored).

kind.description: What to watch: jobs, companies or people.

name.description: A short label, e.g. "Remote Go roles in EU".

name: watch_search

meta.description: Quota and credit standing after this call.

billing.description: live (charged), free_daily (a compact read of the daily allowance), preview (metered, not charged yet), staff, partner or free

credits_left.description: The account balance after this call, in credits.

free_reads_left_today.description: Compact reads still free today for an assistant connected through OAuth (Claude, ChatGPT)

tier.description: anonymous, free, pro, partner or staff
